obligations.statement: The three legs must fold in close to the body and the whole thing becomes narrow and compact when put away.
derivation_premises: Folding requires relative motion between legs and body without interference.

obligations.statement: All parts must remain attached to the stand during folding and storage.
derivation_premises: Any part that separates from the assembly is no longer attached.

obligations.statement: No loose pieces or separate components may be required for folding or opening.
derivation_premises: A loose piece would have to be removed to fold it.

obligations.statement: The user must be able to open the stand by hand, following a logical sequence.
derivation_premises: A hand-operated mechanism requires accessible parts and sufficient manual force.

obligations.statement: When open, the three legs must spread out in different directions to provide a stable footprint on the desk.
derivation_premises: A spread footprint requires legs at distinct angular positions.

obligations.statement: The stand must be openable without tools, motor, or other equipment.
derivation_premises: Manual operation requires that all motions are achievable by hand force.

obligations.statement: When open, the stand must stay open on its own without external support.
derivation_premises: A stable configuration requires that gravity and applied forces do not cause collapse.

obligations.statement: The legs must be prevented from folding back, twisting aside, or coming off during use.
derivation_premises: If a leg can move under load, it will not stay in place.

obligations.statement: The stand must not spontaneously turn, shift, or move in unexpected directions during use.
derivation_premises: Unintended motion would indicate instability or insufficient constraint.

obligations.statement: A deliberate release action must be required before folding, preventing collapse from a knock.
derivation_premises: A mechanism that only unlocks with deliberate input will not unlock from incidental forces.

obligations.statement: After the deliberate release, the stand must fold back to the same compact shape as originally.
derivation_premises: Repeatable folding requires that the final configuration is reachable by the same motion path.

obligations.statement: The opening and folding sequence must be repeatable, with all normal parts remaining attached throughout.
derivation_premises: Repeatable cycles require that the kinematic chain is consistent and not damaged.

obligations.statement: The stand must hold a small object securely on a desk while working.
derivation_premises: A small object must be supported and retained without tipping or sliding.

obligations.statement: The stand must be assemblable in a sensible order and stay together during normal opening and folding.
derivation_premises: Assembly requires that parts can be joined in some sequence and remain engaged.

obligations.statement: The stand must have a stable configuration when open on a flat, horizontal desk surface.
derivation_premises: A stable stand requires that the center of gravity is over the support polygon.

obligations.statement: The stand must support a small object without tipping over under its weight.
derivation_premises: The object's weight applies a load that must be reacted by the desk through the stand.

obligations.statement: The stand must allow a user to reach and operate any release mechanism and the folding legs.
derivation_premises: User access to moving parts is necessary for manual operation.

obligations.statement: The folding mechanism must provide a stable open configuration that resists accidental collapse or movement.
derivation_premises: Some principle families can inherently lock in position, others rely on friction or geometry.

obligations.statement: The stand must have a deliberate release action that is distinct from incidental loading.
derivation_premises: A release mechanism must discriminate between intentional and unintentional forces.

obligations.statement: The stand must be assemblable without special tools or complex sequence, and all parts must remain attached during assembly.
derivation_premises: Assembly requires that parts can be joined without interference and stay connected.

candidates.summary: Candidate using revolute joints with a detent lock for open configuration and a separate release button.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Revolute joints are simple and can be designed to meet folding and opening requirements.

candidates.summary: Candidate using planar joints with a friction hold to maintain open configuration.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Friction holds can be analyzed for stability, but may require precise control.

candidates.summary: Candidate using compliant flexures to allow folding without separate joints, relying on elastic deformation.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Compliant mechanisms require deflection analysis, which is not available at this stage.

unresolved.decision: The choice of mechanism family depends on the relative importance of stiffness, compactness, and cost, which cannot be determined from requirements alone.
unresolved.why_open: The requirements do not provide quantitative targets for compactness (AMB-0001) or specify the nature of the deliberate release action (AMB-0002). Material and manufacturing choices (FRE-0001) and exact dimensions (FRE-0002) are also open, which affect feasibility of each family.

unresolved.decision: The method for achieving a deliberate release (e.g., a button, a latch, a twist) is not determined, and this affects which principle families are viable.
unresolved.why_open: The requirement REQ-0010 does not specify the kind of deliberate action, and Ambiguity AMB-0002 blocks progress. This ambiguity affects all candidates.

assumptions.statement: The stand is used on a flat, horizontal surface (a desk).
assumptions.why: The text mentions 'on my desk' repeatedly, implying a desk surface.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the stand is intended for use on other surfaces.

assumptions.statement: The user has two functioning hands and can perform manual operations without tools.
assumptions.why: The text says 'by hand' and 'no tools', implying manual operation.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the user requires assistive devices or the stand needs tools for operation.

assumptions.statement: The small object is small and light enough to be supported by a stand on a desk without causing tipping.
assumptions.why: The requirement says 'small object' and 'on my desk'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the object is heavy or large, the stand may need additional support.

assumptions.statement: The stand is intended for repeated use, and the materials and mechanisms must withstand normal wear without failing.
assumptions.why: The requirements imply storage and reuse, and durability is implicit.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the stand is intended for single use.
